note: Genre-pack-owned telemetry schema for the 3D top-down extraction-shooter / greed-loop quadrant (dogfood findings; plan §7 'Telemetry Is The Tuning Substrate', backlog High #3/#4/#6). It declares the per-run summary fields and the closed set of event-stream types that a build EMITS so the deterministic `loombridge tuning-report` can aggregate + compare cohorts. Seeded from the dogfood extraction-shooter telemetry set. This replaces ad-hoc debug output: field descriptions carry the naming-honesty rules the dogfood session learned the hard way (a proximity field masquerading as 'seen'; lost-vs-banked ambiguity; unescaped event JSON; stale-vs-fresh summary confusion).

honestyRules.rule: A field derived from DISTANCE/PROXIMITY must be named for what it measures (e.g. `firstEnemyNearMs`, `nearestEnemyDistanceM`) — NEVER `seen`/`spotted`/`detected`. Proximity is not line-of-sight visibility; naming a distance threshold 'seen' overstates what the telemetry knows (the exact dogfood bug).

Value SECURED by extraction (`bankedValue`) and value CARRIED-but-forfeited on death/cancel (`lostValue`) are SEPARATE fields. Never collapse them into one ambiguous `value` — the sign/meaning of a single 'value' field was unreadable in the dogfood project's summaries.

Every event payload string (map tag, route id, reason, hold kind) MUST be emitted as properly-escaped JSON. The dogfood project emitted raw/unescaped strings that broke JSONL parsing; the loader refuses a line that does not parse as a JSON object.

A run summary MUST carry `runId` and `producedAt`. `runId` binds the summary to its event stream: EVERY event must carry `runId` and it must match (a missing per-event `runId` is a refusal, not a skip — else a stale events file renamed onto a fresh summary's stem pairs cleanly). `producedAt` establishes the run is fresh, not a stale re-print, and must be parseable ISO-8601. A summary missing either is REFUSED, never graded (mirrors isFreshGreen's producedAt discipline). RESIDUAL LIMIT (honest): events carry no independent producedAt — freshness rides the summary's producedAt plus the required per-event binding, nothing more.

fields.name: runId
fields.description: Unique id for this run; BINDS the summary to its `<stem>.events.jsonl`. EVERY event must carry `runId` and it must equal this value — a missing per-event `runId` is a refusal, not a skip. RESIDUAL LIMIT (honest): events carry no independent `producedAt`; freshness rides the summary's `producedAt` plus this required per-event binding, nothing more. Must be unique across a run-set: a duplicate runId refuses the WHOLE set (it would silently double-count the run in every aggregate).

fields.name: producedAt
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the summary was WRITTEN. Freshness anchor — a missing/empty value is refused, and an unparseable value is refused (a timestamp that cannot be placed in time cannot establish freshness). Distinguishes fresh output from a stale re-print.

fields.name: map
fields.description: Map tag (e.g. `map1-starter`, `map2-route`). Segmentation dimension; the dogfood project split a short starter map from a longer route-test map.

fields.name: persona
fields.description: Scripted-bot persona intent for this run (e.g. `timid`/`balanced`/`greedy`/`reckless`). Segmentation dimension. Balance evidence, NOT a fun verdict.

fields.name: route
fields.description: Route the run took through the arena (e.g. `north-loop`, `direct-extract`). Segmentation dimension for route-choice analysis.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Terminal outcome: `extracted` (banked), `died` (lost), or `cancelled` (bailed the extraction). Segmentation dimension. Distinct from the value fields below.

fields.name: runDurationMs
fields.description: Wall-clock length of the run, start to terminal outcome. Aggregated (mean/min/max) to sanity-check arena scale against target session duration.

fields.name: firstPickupMs
fields.description: Time from run start to FIRST loot pickup of any tier. Aggregated.

fields.name: firstHighValueMs
fields.description: Time from run start to the first HIGH-VALUE loot pickup — the greed-escalation moment. Aggregated.

fields.name: firstEnemyNearMs
fields.description: Time from run start to the first moment an enemy came within the danger-proximity threshold. PROXIMITY-DERIVED — honestly named 'near', NOT 'seen' (honesty rule proximity-is-not-seen). Aggregated.

fields.name: extractionStartMs
fields.description: Time from run start to when the player BEGAN the extraction hold. Aggregated (null/omitted on runs that never reached extraction).

fields.name: extractionCompleteMs
fields.description: Time from run start to a COMPLETED extraction. Omitted on runs that died/cancelled before completing. Aggregated.

fields.name: bankedValue
fields.description: Value SECURED via a completed extraction. HONEST: distinct from `lostValue`; do not merge (honesty rule banked-vs-lost-distinct). Aggregated.

fields.name: lostValue
fields.description: Value the player was CARRYING but forfeited on death/cancel. HONEST: distinct from `bankedValue`. Aggregated — the greed-risk signal.

fields.name: nearestEnemyDistanceMinM
fields.description: Closest an enemy got over the whole run, in metres. PROXIMITY, not visibility. Aggregated — a pressure proxy.

eventStream.note: GROUND-TRUTHED against the real dogfood-project TelemetryLogger event stream (PlaytestData/run_*_events.jsonl — 259 files, ~63k events, 17 types; T3-T). Corrections this ground-truthing applied to the pre-real model: (1) `t` is SECONDS (float, ~0.5s sampling step), NOT ms; (2) the stream is ONE globally time-sorted sequence — every one of the 259 real captures is globally monotonic non-decreasing, so `global` (not per-entity keyed by an `enemyId` that does not exist) is the honest ordering contract; (3) real type NAMES are `player_pos`/`enemy_pos`/… not `*_position_sample`, and combat/loot/extract/bot rows exist that the model omitted; (4) MERGED payloads — `player_pos` carries stash/heat/holdKind/holdProgress/nearestEnemyDist INLINE, not as separate sample events; (5) the arena is XZ-planar with NO `y` height field. RESIDUAL LIMIT (migration, see EMITTER-MIGRATION.md): the real emitter stamps NO per-event run-binding field, so a real events file still REFUSES the run-binding gate (`runId` MISSING on every event) until the game's emitter adds it — that refusal is the fresh-not-stale binding moat working, not a schema bug.

events.description: Periodic sample of the player's world position PLUS the merged greed-loop state the real emitter folds into the same row (stash carried, heat/pressure, current hold, nearest-enemy proximity). Top-down arena is XZ-planar — there is NO y height field.

payload.name: t
payload.description: Run-relative timestamp in SECONDS (~0.5s step); globally monotonic non-decreasing across the whole stream.

payload.name: stash
payload.description: Value CARRIED (not yet banked) at this sample. Merged inline by the real emitter.

payload.name: heat
payload.description: Accumulated pressure/heat level at this sample. Merged inline.

payload.name: holdKind
payload.description: Active hold at this sample (e.g. `none`/`loot`/`extract`). Must be escaped JSON (honesty rule escape-event-json).

payload.name: holdProgress
payload.description: Progress of the active hold in [0,1] (0 when holdKind is `none`).

payload.name: nearestEnemyDist
payload.description: Distance to the nearest enemy in metres, or -1 when no enemy is present. PROXIMITY, not line-of-sight — honestly named `nearestEnemyDist`, NEVER `seen` (honesty rule proximity-is-not-seen).

events.description: Periodic sample of one enemy's world position and its distance to the player.

payload.name: id
payload.description: Per-run enemy instance id (integer in the real emitter).

payload.name: kind
payload.description: Enemy archetype tag. Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: dist
payload.description: This enemy's distance to the player in metres. PROXIMITY, not visibility (honesty rule proximity-is-not-seen).

events.description: A fired shot connected with a target.

payload.name: target
payload.description: What was hit (e.g. enemy kind/id). Must be escaped JSON.

events.description: Player took damage. `duringHold` flags the greed-vs-risk moment (damage taken while in a loot/extract hold).

payload.name: source
payload.description: What dealt the damage. Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: duringHold
payload.description: True when the damage landed WHILE the player was in a hold — the greed-vs-risk signal.

events.description: An enemy spawned into the arena.
Player began a loot-secure hold at a container. `tier` drives loot-tier stats.

payload.name: id
payload.description: Container id. Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: tier
payload.description: Loot tier (e.g. `low`/`mid`/`high`). Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: value
payload.description: Point value on offer from this container.

events.description: Player completed a loot-secure hold; `stash` is the resulting carried total.

payload.name: value
payload.description: Value secured from this container.

payload.name: stash
payload.description: Total value now CARRIED (not yet banked) after this pickup.

events.description: A loot-secure hold was interrupted before completing.
Enemy pressure began (the first-enemy trigger). `reason` and `afterLootDelay` explain WHY/WHEN pressure arrived.

payload.name: reason
payload.description: Why pressure triggered (e.g. `high_rush`, `after_first_loot`). Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: afterLootDelay
payload.description: Seconds between the first loot and this pressure trigger (-1 when not loot-triggered).

events.description: Player died; carried value is FORFEITED (`lost`), never banked (honesty rule banked-vs-lost-distinct).

payload.name: lost
payload.description: Value the player was CARRYING and forfeited on death. Distinct from any banked value.

events.description: Player began the extraction hold at a zone.

payload.name: id
payload.description: Extraction zone id. Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: value
payload.description: Value carried into the extraction hold.

events.description: An extraction hold was interrupted before completing.
Extraction completed; carried value is BANKED (`banked`), distinct from any lost value (honesty rule banked-vs-lost-distinct).

payload.name: banked
payload.description: Value SECURED by this completed extraction. Distinct from `death.lost`.

events.description: Scripted-bot state transition (bot runs only). Adds bot intent/persona rows to the SAME stream (design doc §Telemetry requirements) — never replaces the player/combat/loot rows.

payload.name: persona
payload.description: Bot persona id (e.g. `timid`/`balanced`/`greedy`/`reckless`). Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: from
payload.description: State transitioned FROM. Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: to
payload.description: State transitioned TO. Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: reason
payload.description: Why the transition fired. Must be escaped JSON.

payload.name: nearestEnemyDist
payload.description: PROXIMITY to the nearest enemy at the transition, not visibility (honesty rule proximity-is-not-seen).

events.description: Scripted-bot target selection (bot runs only). Records WHICH target the bot chose and its scoring inputs.

payload.name: dist
payload.description: Distance to the chosen target. PROXIMITY (honesty rule proximity-is-not-seen).

payload.name: score
payload.description: Heuristic score the bot assigned this target.
